title: The Cheap Bottom Bracket Mistake On My Light Carbon LCR018-D

takeaways.text: The US$15 optional T47 bottom bracket supplied with the frame began creaking before 1,000 km and needed a spacer for preload; cleaning and regreasing did not cure it.
Swapping in a known-good bottom bracket stopped the noise for a week of commuting; he rates the frame highly but advises skipping the optional bottom bracket.

disclosure: Owner video; no sponsorship is stated.
summary: Follow-up on a creak from the optional bottom bracket supplied with the owner's LCR018-D.
